what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Nigeria in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 22291 Nigerian asylum seekers in Canada, 39.7% of all asylum seekers from Nigeria.
Refugees from Nigeria, a separate group, live mostly in the Niger, Cameroon, Chad and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Nigeria with JAS in 2009 and from 2011 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Nigeria from 2015 to 2025, at war level in most of those years, and over Biafra territory with IPOB from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 795 asylum seekers.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2019 and 2024 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
